by: claude: gaps for regional money figures and trust counts
note: Gap records: money figures for the Basque provinces and the Swiss cantons (no source splits them), and the trust count for eight countries (no register publishes one).

gaps.detail: Álava: Eurostat publishes business owners (employers) only for the Basque Country as a whole (NUTS 2 ES21), not per province; UBS and Knight Frank publish no regional figures.
gaps.where_to_get: Eustat (the Basque statistics office): employed persons by professional status per territory (Álava, Bizkaia, Gipuzkoa), the PRA labour survey. Save the table in PDFs/ and tell Claude.

gaps.detail: Belgium: The UBO register (FPS Finance) has a section for trusts but publishes no count.
gaps.where_to_get: FPS Finance (UBO register) or the Belgian FIU (CTIF-CFI) annual report: the number of trusts registered.

gaps.detail: Germany: The Transparency Register (Bundesanzeiger) counts entries per legal form; the latest official count found (Bundestag Drucksache 20/3221, 17 Aug 2022) has a row for trusts, but its table does not read reliably as text, so no figure is stored.
gaps.where_to_get: Bundestag Drucksache 20/3221 (https://dserver.bundestag.de/btd/20/032/2003221.pdf), answer 2: the number for "TR-Trust"; or a newer government answer. Tell Claude the number and its date.

gaps.detail: France: The trust register (registre des trusts, DGFiP) publishes no count; the only figure seen (about 16,000 trusts known to the tax administration) is from 2016 and secondary.
gaps.where_to_get: DGFiP annual report or a parliamentary answer giving the number of trusts in the registre des trusts. Save it in PDFs/ and tell Claude.

gaps.detail: Italy: The beneficial-owner register (Registro dei titolari effettivi, trust section) publishes no count.
gaps.where_to_get: Unioncamere / the business register (Registro delle imprese): the number of trusts registered in the titolari effettivi section. Save it in PDFs/ and tell Claude.

gaps.detail: Portugal: The beneficial-owner register (RCBE, IRN) publishes no count of trusts (fundos fiduciários).
gaps.where_to_get: IRN: RCBE statistics by type of entity, including trusts. Save it in PDFs/ and tell Claude.

gaps.detail: Spain: The register of beneficial owners (Registro de Titularidades Reales, Ministry of Justice) publishes no count of trusts.
gaps.where_to_get: Ministry of Justice: the number of trusts (fideicomisos) in the Registro de Titularidades Reales. Save it in PDFs/ and tell Claude.

gaps.detail: Switzerland: Swiss law has no trust of its own and there is no trust register, so no count exists.
gaps.where_to_get: Nothing to fetch unless a study estimates the number of trusts administered in Switzerland (e.g. the Swiss Association of Trust Companies, SATC). Save it in PDFs/ and tell Claude.

gaps.detail: South Africa: No count of trusts found: SARS publishes how many trusts filed income tax returns (84,134 for the 2024 tax year), which is a different measure, and the Master of the High Court publishes no register total.
gaps.where_to_get: Master of the High Court annual report (trusts registered) or SARS Tax Statistics (trusts registered for income tax). Save it in PDFs/ and tell Claude.
